descriptionChirho: Second-person plural possessive pronoun/adjective meaning 'your' or 'yours,' used across all cases (nominative, accusative, genitive, dative) and genders to attribute ownership or association to the addressees. Confirmed by uniform multilingual glosses: arb كُم, heb שֶׁלָּכֶם, hin तुम्हारी/तुम्हारा, kor 너희의, spa vuestro/vuestra. Occurs in John 7:6; 8:17; 15:20; Luke 6:20; 16:12; Acts 27:34; Rom 11:31; 1 Cor 15:31; 16:17; 2 Cor 8:8; Gal 6:13.
